name: testing-blocks trigger queries
description: Should trigger when validating completed EDS block/script/style changes in a browser, running lint/tests before a PR, or deciding/writing unit and Playwright E2E tests for a block; near misses are implementing block JS/CSS (building-blocks / CDD), reviewing a PR without running tests (code-review), finding pages that use a block (find-test-content), and dev-server setup (aem-cli).

queries.query: The `tabs` block in `blocks/tabs/` is finished and has a library page at `/docs/library/blocks/tabs`, but it has no tests. Add the unit and E2E tests it needs.
I just finished modifying `blocks/cards/cards.js` and `cards.css`, and my test page is running at `http://localhost:3000/drafts/cards`. Run the pre-PR validation and browser checks.
Write a Playwright E2E spec for our `accordion` block that tests keyboard navigation, ARIA expanded state, and that clicking a header fires the analytics event.
Add unit tests for `blocks/pricing/pricing.js` covering its price-parsing helper and how `decorate()` handles authored rows with missing cells.
We just added a simple CSS-only `quote (centered)` variant and a complex `carousel` block with keyboard controls. Which tests should we commit for each in this EDS repo?
Verify our updated `hero` block in a real browser across mobile, tablet and desktop viewports on `http://localhost:3000/drafts/hero`, check for console errors, and capture screenshots.

Our Playwright spec for the `tabs` block keeps breaking every time authors edit the tab titles on the library page or we rename internal classes in `decorate()`. Rewrite the spec so it follows EDS E2E conventions.
I want to add unit tests for helper functions in `blocks/search/search.js`, but this `aem-boilerplate` repo has no test script in `package.json`. How should we approach testing it?
Build a new `timeline` block from scratch: design the content model for authors, create test content, and write `timeline.js` and `timeline.css`.
Find all pages on `main--site--org.aem.page` that currently contain the `cards` block and list which variants each page uses.
Review PR #42 on GitHub and post inline review comments on any CSS scoping or performance issues in the diff.
Start `aem up` in this git worktree without stopping the dev server running in my main checkout.
In `blocks/columns/columns.js`, update `decorate()` so cells containing only a `<picture>` get the `columns-img-col` class. Only change `columns.js`.
Upload `drafts/promo.html` to `admin.da.live` and trigger a preview so it's live on `.aem.page`.
Fix the selectors in `blocks/cards/cards.css` so they use the CSS custom properties from `styles/styles.css` and logical properties instead of `margin-left`.
